title: UniT: Toward a Unified Physical Language for Human-to-Humanoid Policy Learning and World Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2604.19734v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scaling humanoid foundation models is bottlenecked by the scarcity of robotic data. While massive egocentric human data offers a scalable alternative, bridging the cross-embodiment chasm remains a fundamental challenge due to kinematic mismatches. We introduce UniT (Unified Latent Action Tokenizer via Visual Anchoring), a framework that establishes a unified physical language for human-to-humanoid transfer. Grounded in the philosophy that heterogeneous kinematics share universal visual consequences, UniT employs a tri-branch cross-reconstruction mechanism: actions predict vision to anchor kinematics to physical outcomes, while vision reconstructs actions to filter out irrelevant visual confounders. Concurrently, a fusion branch synergies these purified modalities into a shared discrete latent space of embodiment-agnostic physical intents. translated_title: UniT：面向人-人形机器人策略学习与世界建模的统一物理语言
translated_abstract: 扩展人形机器人基础模型受到机器人数据稀缺的瓶颈制约。尽管大规模的第一人称视角人类数据提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但由于运动学失配，弥合跨本体差异仍是根本性挑战。我们提出 UniT（基于视觉锚定的统一潜在动作分词器），这是一个为人-人形机器人迁移建立统一物理语言的框架。基于异构运动学共享普遍视觉后果的理念，UniT 采用三分支交叉重构机制：由动作预测视觉，将运动学锚定到物理结果上；由视觉重构动作，以过滤掉不相关的视觉干扰因素。同时，一个融合分支将这些净化后的模态协同融合到一个与本体无关的物理意图共享离散潜在空间中。我们在两个范式中验证了 UniT：1）策略学习（VLA-UniT）：通过预测这些……
tldr: UniT 通过“动作预测视觉、视觉重构动作”的三分支交叉重构机制，构建与本体无关的统一物理语言，使人类第一人称数据能够迁移到人形机器人上，实现跨本体的策略学习与世界建模。
